reason: The episode created a complete Paperclip Operations Agent configuration including hire-payload.json with adapterConfig/runtimeConfig/desiredSkills/permissions, AGENTS.md with managed bundle instructions, .paperclip.yaml vendor extension, and hire-agent.sh script. This pattern should be reusable for future operations agents.

Add clarification that agent ID and company ID are assigned by Paperclip at hire time, not pre-configured locally. The hire-payload.json uses template placeholders that get substituted when hire-agent.sh runs.

The episode revealed a Telegram bot configuration co-located with the Paperclip Operations Agent that wasn't documented in the setup skill. This patch adds a reference so future sessions know about the optional Telegram integration when setting up the agent.
Add cross-reference to the official plugin skill to clarify the two Telegram integration approaches (co-located bot vs official plugin via Channels).
